# `provenance` command

Print what a result produced now would depend on: commit and uncommitted change, dependency pins, the mode's
compiler with its version and flags, loaded environment modules, machine and GPUs. Every case run records the
same.

```bash
fobis provenance [--mode M] [--json]
```

How to use it, with examples: [Verifying results](/cookbook/verification).

## All options

| Option | Value | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--fobos`, `-f` | TEXT |  | Specify a "fobos" file named differently from "fobos" |
| `--fci` |  |  | Assume fobos inputs as case insensitive |
| `--mode` | TEXT |  | Select a mode defined into a fobos file |
| `--json` |  |  | Emit structured JSON to stdout instead of human-readable output (useful for scripting / agents) |
